extensions.description: Start an episode on the task with this id.
Submit a plan as the submit_plan tool does, outside the agent's tool calls.

tools.name: check_plan
tools.description:
Check your plan: rule violations per ship, departure and delay per ship, and the plan's cost.
Uses one of your checks. It does not grade the plan.

tools.name: get_situation
tools.description: The quay, notices, ships already alongside, closed sections and the table of ships to berth.

tools.name: submit_plan
tools.description: Submit your final berth plan. Ends the episode; the plan is graded once.
